This is my main field, so I will put the fertilizer I got on it — one bag of NPK and one bag of urea — though I have to spread it across the whole plot because it is bigger than the half-hectare they recommend. I will plant the hybrid seed too, since it does better when there is fertilizer in the soil. My family will do most of the work, but I will hire about ten days of ganyu labor when we do the ridging. I cannot afford chemicals or irrigation, so we depend on the rains and our own hands.
